name: epic-map-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the EPIC.map API, the federated map remote and the host application that embeds it.

scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @bcgov/epic-map && npm run lint --workspace map-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bcgov/epic-map-types && npm run typecheck --workspace @bcgov/epic-map
